title: Does a lot of things right!
body: There are lots of habit apps out there. This is one of the most promising: (1) It is developed by a dedicated team which repeatedly has demonstrated its competence, and works full-time on improvements while making a living out of the app. (2) The development is responsive and relatively transparent. For example customer support promptly answers questions, their website includes a roadmap on planned features and those currently being developed, and users can request and vote on features, with the most popular ones being implemented quite quickly (around 2 per month over the last 5).
